research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Mashgin is researching a method and system for item identification that determines visual information, computes encodings, and outputs an item identifier, and an automated object recognition kiosk for retail checkouts that uses a controller and imaging device. It develops a system and method for identifying items via point clouds, region masks, and surface reconstruction, separation of objects in images from three dimensional cameras, and a multi batch self checkout system and method of use.

overview_description.description: Mashgin's builds A.I. based self-checkout systems that are deployed widely across thousands of locations including most of the top stadiums, airports and venues in the United States. The technology is also deployed widely across thousands of gas stations and convenience stores in the US. The company was founded in 2014 and is based in Palo Alto, California. Mashgin is growing and is extremely profitable.
